title: How To Use Location Extensions In Google Ads - Store Growers

facts.fact: Google My Business business name has a maximum of 80 characters.
Google My Business street address has a maximum of 80 characters.
Google My Business URL has a maximum of 35 characters.
The article states that advertisers pay for clicks that take customers to their site and also for clicks that give searchers more details on their location.
facts.quote: You pay for clicks that take your potential customer to your site, but also for clicks that give searchers more details on your location.

facts.fact: Location extensions can only show up next to Google Search Ads, while Local Inventory Ads in Google Shopping leverage physical presence instead.
facts.quote: Location extensions can only show up next to Google Search Ads.

facts.fact: Google's guidance says to use only one Google My Business profile for a business to avoid location extension issues.
facts.quote: To avoid any location extension issues, use only one profile for your business.

facts.fact: Curated locations are mostly bigger chains that Google has in its index, and adding them automatically includes all of their locations.
facts.quote: Curated locations are basically locations that Google has in its index. They are mostly bigger chains.

facts.fact: Local inventory ads, a Google Shopping feature, require a product feed of in-stock items for each location.
facts.quote: Local inventory ads are a specific feature for Google Shopping, which have additional requirements. (You have to provide a product feed of in stock items for each location).

facts.fact: Local inventory ads are only available in a limited number of countries, and the page does not name a number.
facts.quote: Unlike location extensions, local inventory ads are only available in a limited number of countries.

facts.fact: To use location extensions, the advertiser must first link its Google My Business and Google Ads accounts.
facts.quote: To get started with location extensions, you have to first link your Google My Business and Google Ads accounts.

facts.fact: Location extensions can be added at the account, campaign, or specific ad group level.
facts.quote: After you can simply add them to your account, campaign or a specific ad group.

facts.fact: Once set up, location extensions show with ads in both Google search results and Google Maps results.
facts.quote: Once that’s done, they will show up with ads both in the search results and Google Maps results.
